usage: 噚日 is used to refer to the day before today.
It functions as a noun, often placed before verbs or time expressions to indicate when something happened.
It can appear at the beginning or middle of a sentence depending on emphasis.
When talking about activities or events, 噚日 helps specify that they occurred yesterday.
It's a very common everyday word and can be shortened to 喺噚日 in casual speech.
